messages:
emma_cust: Hey support — our org dashboard shows a 14-day trial credit grant (see dashboard snapshot: https://files.redwood.example/ss/xyz.png) but our service keys are still getting billed and the usage API returns no credits applied. No invoices yet but tokens are being consumed. can someone look?

sarah_support: sorry — that’s not expected. can you paste the project_id and the service key ID? also which endpoint are you calling (hosted/dedicated/private)?

emma_cust: project_id: proj_9z3f7q, service_key: sk_live_abc12345, hosted (api.redwood.example). quick curl we run is:```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_abc12345" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1.2","input":"hello"}'
```
response 200, tokens returned, but console "Usage" shows 0 consumption for that service key and org-level credits still at full amount.

sarah_support: thanks. i'm going to pull logs and check billing attribution. pinging @raj_engineer and @billing-bot for sync info.

billing-bot: Billing sync job (org: org_47k) completed. last_event_processed=2026-10-03T14:01:20Z, events_ingested=482. Next scheduled sync in 3m.

raj_engineer: quick check — the usage events are being ingested but attributed to project proj_legacy_42, not proj_9z3f7q. looks like the service key was rotated and the old org mapping stuck in the ingestion pipeline.

emma_cust: oh interesting — we did rotate keys last week and created a new project. could that cause it?

raj_engineer: yeah — if the usage envelope contains the old project_id header it'll go to the old project. can you run the request with trace header so we can see what your client is sending? e.g.:
```bash
curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_abc12345" 
  -H "x-redwood-trace: true" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1.2","input":"test trace"}'
```

emma_cust: ran it — attaching console output snippet:```
> GET /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
> Host: api.redwood.example
> authorization: Bearer sk_live_abc12345
> x-redwood-trace: true
< HTTP/1.1 200 OK
< x-redwood-project: proj_legacy_42
< x-request-id: req_0a1b2c
```

raj_engineer: ah there it is — the gateway is stamping x-redwood-project with proj_legacy_42. that means the service key metadata points to the old project in our key-store.

mike_oncall: for immediate remediation I can run an internal resync to re-attribute recent events to proj_9z3f7q and also reassign the key mapping. steps: 1) reassign key -> new project 2) run /internal/billing/reallocate?from=proj_legacy_42&to=proj_9z3f7q&since=2026-10-01T00:00:00Z. this will move usage events and cause credits to be consumed in console.

sarah_support: mike, do we need a customer downtime window?

mike_oncall: no downtime — it's a backfill job. estimate ~2-5m for the event window. I'll run it now if you confirm.

emma_cust: please run it. we want credits to start applying. thanks.

mike_oncall: running reassign, job started. job id jb_7721.

billing-bot: Billing reallocation job jb_7721 started. affected_events=~240, estimated_runtime=3m.

raj_engineer: after backfill completes, API usage endpoint should reflect consumption and trial balance will decrease. also fixed the key-store mapping so new requests will be attributed correctly.

billing-bot: Billing reallocation job jb_7721 completed. events_reassigned=242, duration=2m27s.

emma_cust: just confirmed — usage API now shows tokens consumed and trial credit dropped from 1000 to 856. console usage graphs updated. thanks! :tada:

sarah_support: great — closing the loop. root cause: key rotation left stale project mapping in key-store; workaround applied and backfill completed. we've added a validation to the key rotation flow to prevent stale mapping.

emma_cust: awesome, appreciate the quick turnaround.

mike_oncall: leaving a note on the incident board: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-1003. follow-up: automation ticket created to run a nightly key mapping audit.

sarah_support: reopening if anything else crops up. :thumbsup:
